title: Deposit fees are not transferred to fee recipient in `ElytraDepositPoolV1`
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `ElytraDepositPoolV1` contract has an inconsistency in fee handling between deposits and withdrawals. While withdrawal fees are correctly transferred to the `feeRecipient`, deposit fees are calculated and deducted from user deposits but never actually transferred to the fee recipient.
